slice.title: Cross-section
slice.planeHelp: Drag the blue handle in the 3D view, or use the offset slider to move the cutting plane.

volume.title: 3D orbital
volume.help: Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate. Plus and minus zoom. Azimuth and elevation sliders also rotate the view.
volume.orbitDescription: Rotate the focused 3D view with the Left, Right, Up and Down arrow keys.
volume.zoomDescription: Zoom the focused 3D view with the plus or minus key.
volume.probeHelp: Move the radial cursor and highlight the corresponding spherical shell in the 3D view. Zero hides the shell.

screenSummary.playArea: Explore the orbital as a volume, probability dots, or a 90% or 95% isosurface. The radial chart shares a probe with the 3D view. The cross-section shows the selected cutting plane.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose quantum numbers, real or complex angular functions, charge, rendering mode and stationary-state presets. Toggle 3D or slice nodes. Camera sliders, the radial probe slider and the plane offset slider provide keyboard control.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Change n, l and m to see how the orbital's size, shape and nodes change. Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate. Plus and minus zoom. Azimuth and elevation sliders also rotate the view.

orbitals.currentDetails: {{state}} of {{ion}}. Energy {{energy}} electronvolts. Mean radius {{radius}} Bohr radii. {{radialNodes}} radial nodes and {{angularNodes}} angular nodes.

controls.principalHelp: From 1 to 5. Sets the energy and the overall size of the orbital.
controls.orbitalHelp: From 0 to n minus 1. Sets the shape and the number of angular nodes.
controls.magneticHelp: From minus l to l. Sets the orientation, or how fast the phase winds around the z-axis.
controls.nuclearChargeHelp: Larger charge pulls the electron closer; the orbital shrinks as one over Z.
controls.offsetHelp: Moves the cross-section along the axis perpendicular to it.
controls.complexBasis: Complex spherical harmonics Y l m
controls.realBasis: Real orbitals such as p x and d x y

screenSummary.playArea: The 3D view shows a coherent superposition. The graph tracks mean radius and mean z position over time.
screenSummary.controlArea: Mix up to six hydrogenic states using quantum numbers, coefficient magnitudes and phases. Choose a preset, rendering mode, charge and playback speed.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Play, pause or step through time. Arrow keys rotate the focused 3D view; plus and minus zoom. Sliders provide keyboard equivalents.

superposition.currentDetails: {{count}} distinct occupied states. Time {{time}} femtoseconds. Mean z {{z}} Bohr radii and mean radius {{r}} Bohr radii.
